answer: To resist Sybils, require every identity to generate a unique sequential spiral of memory-hard state transitions starting from a non-transferable relic of bonded collateral. Each step produces a verifiable pearl of intermediate state that must be retained in a private working set; the next transition is valid only if the full prior spiral is present. An attacker spawning n fakes must therefore hold n independent working sets whose memory cost grows with spiral depth, so the marginal cost of each extra identity rises super-linearly and cannot be pooled across clones.
